title: 미움이 안 돼
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A lush string section provides legato pads and counter-melodies. The track is in the key of G Major with a tempo of 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance utilizes a breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a more resonant chest voice as the phrasing develops. High-frequency reverb is applied to the vocals to create a sense of space. The piano uses a wide stereo image with a warm, natural timbre. The strings are mixed with a slow attack and long release.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained piano chords, legato string pads]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
창문에 빗줄기가 흘러
네 번호 위에
손가락이 멈춰 지우려 했는데
화면만 보고 있어 불 꺼진 방 안이야
빗소리가 차가워 숨이 가빠져
너 없는 밤이 이렇게 길어
미워할 수 있다면
이렇게 안 아플 텐데
